full.description: The existing complete extension catalog. Optional extensions retain their existing installation policy.

lite.description: Formatting, normal import/path and Tailwind IntelliSense, paired-tag editing, Russian UI, icons and Workstation helpers. Filters new installations only; never uninstalls extensions.
lite.omittedRationale: SQL Server, React snippets, an additional formatter, image/import-size previews and editor decorations remain available through full. The managed theme is built into the editor. No AI completion provider is added or re-enabled by either profile.
